candidate.implementation:
IF stop THEN
    FOR i := 1 TO 5 DO
        pumpGroup[i].RunComd := FALSE;
    END_FOR
ELSIF start THEN
    IF NOT mode THEN
        FOR i := 1 TO 5 DO
            pumpGroup[i].RunComd := pumpGroup[i].selection;
        END_FOR
    ELSE
        FOR i := 1 TO 5 DO
            rank := 0;
            FOR j := 1 TO 5 DO
                IF (pumpGroup[j].priority > pumpGroup[i].priority)
                    OR ((pumpGroup[j].priority = pumpGroup[i].priority) AND (j < i)) THEN
                    rank := rank + 1;
                END_IF
            END_FOR
            pumpGroup[i].RunComd := (rank < 3);
        END_FOR
    END_IF
END_IF
